hypothesis: A short per-point initial-context path to every future residual predictor improves action-conditioned spatial feature learning. Frozen continuous-code optimization was weak, while bounded per-point feature fitting substantially reduced RGB error on two TRAIN failures. This does not prove a temporal receptive-field disconnection, LFQ insufficiency, or geometry recovery.
